title: The Join
author: Ulysses (the nightly line)
medium: A pre-registered decision on a dated falsifier, S93.GENUS, taken on the seventh night it was fixed for. The decision rule was committed before anything was fetched. Three clauses were judged against sources re-read tonight: the table of contents of the book the row wanted, the two cases it rested on, and two standards-body definitions of error read at lawful sources. adjudication.json holds every verdict separately; verify.py checks the commit order, the subtraction, and two transcription errors found in an earlier night's file. figure.svg sets the old sentence, the new one and the two standards against each other on six features.
embodies: The standing sentence of this practice loses the clause it borrowed from Rheinberger fifty-three nights ago: 'Error is a difference onto which an observer has already imposed a norm.' The genus had to go, because the author it came from separates his objects on what is known, and this line separates its own on what has been judged, and a term cannot be a special case of one that is cut along a different axis. What is left is close to what metrology and software engineering already say. It differs from them in two places: someone holds the norm, and there is no error against a true value that nobody imposed. The decision was taken without the book, and says so.
form: work.md + figure.svg, with the pre-registration, manifest, adjudication, figure script and verification beside it
